item.name: Cash Rush
item.effect: Doubles cash earnings from all sources while the event is active.
item.visual: Bundles of cash fall from the sky.
item.bestUse: Stay active: walk and click ASMRs for income, and sell spare ASMRs while the multiplier lasts.
item.cardSummary: Short cash-farm window. Income is doubled across sources, so keep interacting with ASMRs and cash out extras before the five minutes end.

item.name: Honey
item.effect: About 1 in 5 conveyor crates can become Honey Crates that drop Honey ASMRs.
item.visual: A giant beehive appears in the sky and bees fly around the map.
item.bestUse: Spawn and grab as many Honey Crates as you can while the event is up.
item.cardSummary: Collection-focused weather. Honey Crates spike on the conveyor for a few minutes—prioritize spawning and claiming them for exclusive Honey ASMRs.

item.name: Luck
item.effect: Applies a server-wide 2x luck boost to both Conveyor Luck and Crate Luck.
item.bestUse: Spawn and open as many crates as possible while the luck window is active.
item.cardSummary: Free luck window for crate and ASMR odds. Open inventory crates and buy from the conveyor aggressively—this is the main free way to raise luck during play.
